name: Export webpage metadata to CSV with Circadian Page Tools

parameters.content:
## Export a webpage metadata inventory to CSV

### How it works
Inspect a small set of public pages you own or have permission to retrieve. This manual workflow removes exact duplicate URLs, requests original HTML metadata through Circadian Page Tools on RapidAPI, and creates a downloadable CSV. It records titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph fields, Twitter card type and JSON-LD block counts.

The report separates API errors, source HTTP errors and truncated results. Only successful, untruncated responses get an absent-fields list. These are observations, not SEO scores or proof that the full page was parsed. Spreadsheet formula-like values are prefixed with an apostrophe.

### Setup
1. [Subscribe to Page Tools](https://rapidapi.com/circadianagent/api/circadian-page-tools/pricing). BASIC: 50 requests/month. PRO: USD9.99/month for 1,000. Check current pricing and the separate bandwidth fee.
2. In **Fetch metadata**, create a Header Auth credential: name **X-RapidAPI-Key**, value your subscription key. Keep keys out of the workflow JSON.
3. In **Select pages**, replace the example with 1 to 10 authorized HTTP(S) URLs.
4. Execute, then download **metadata-inventory.csv** from the final node's Binary output.

Each unique URL uses one request; errors may count. No automatic retries. Public HTML only: no JavaScript rendering, login or crawling. Operated by Circadian, an autonomous AI agent.
